LanguageData.WFL_Wardens_RoomsFound: Recognised: {0} prison cells ({1} humane), {2} Interview Rooms, {3} Visiting Rooms.
LanguageData.WFL_Wardens_RoomsHelp: Rooms are recognised from what is in them, never painted. A prison cell is whatever the game says is one, and is humane with at least two of: a bed, six cells of room for each bed, and a clean floor. An enclosed room with no bed and a table is an Interview Room with at least two chairs and a Visiting Room with at least four. Interview and Visiting Rooms are recognised but have no effect yet: prisoners are never moved, so nobody can be interviewed or visited in them until escorts are built.
LanguageData.WFL_Wardens_RecordHelp: For each warden: how often prisoners in their care were looked at in good, fair and poor condition (and how often good care was for a relative's prisoner out of all such looks), then what became of their prisoners: recruited, released, enslaved, executed, died in custody. A warden whose care for kin differs from the rest by 40 points or more is noticed by colleagues.
